connectors.name: Left 1x6 header (front view)
connectors.orderNote: No printed numbers; started at the bottom end, closest to the Type-C connector

connectors.name: Labeled pads on back-view inset (top left)
connectors.orderNote: No printed numbers; started at the end closest to the USB-C connector visible at the bottom of the back-view inset (lowest pad first, by vertical position)

uncertain: Back-view inset pads (GND, VBUS, D_M, D_N, SDA, SCL) are staggered in a zigzag with a gap before SDA/SCL; whether they form one connector or two groups (USB pads and I2C pads), and the exact order of the staggered SDA/SCL pair, is left open by the image. They may also be test pads rather than a wiring connector.
notes: DC 5~12V screw terminal has no individual pin labels and was skipped (rule 1). Mini PCIe adapter, TF card, SIM card, LAN8720 and WS2812 callouts list on-board signal assignments without pin positions and were not transcribed. Left header label GND is printed in grey and 3V3 in red; colours omitted.
